cards.answer: Nasus is a fighter/tank whose Q grows permanently stronger through kills and whose W progressively reduces movement and attack speed. Q deals physical damage, while E and R deal magic damage; R also grants defensive stats and lets him use Q more often.
cards.counterplay: Pressure his Q farming and keep your distance when he empowers himself.

cards.answer: Siphoning Strike empowers Nasus's next basic attack with extra range and physical damage, and resets his attack timer. Killing the target with it permanently strengthens future Q attacks, with greater gains from champions, large minions and large monsters.
cards.counterplay: Contest his last hits and avoid lingering within his empowered attack range.
